patches.line_endings: CRLF preserved so the diff shows only these changes
not_changed: model architecture, tokenizer, special tokens, optimiser, loss
the EFDDataset loader and the relation/argument feature construction
what: inline per-epoch inference lifted into _infer() and _report() so dev and test are scored by the same code path
dev-selected result and upstream epoch-max both written to --report_out
patches.why: Upstream evaluates --test_data every epoch and reports max-over-epochs of the test macro-F1 (its checkpoint-saving line is commented out), which is selection on the evaluation set. This fork adds a required --dev_data, picks the epoch by dev macro-F1, reports the test metrics of that epoch, and still reports the upstream epoch-max number so the two protocols can be compared.

why_vendored: gpu-4090 cannot resolve github.com, and the project rule is that code reaches the server through git. Vendoring the three files the EFD experiment needs makes every later patch a reviewable diff instead of an untracked edit on the server.
